info.title: Nero AI Image Upscaler
info.description: Power Automate/Power Apps connector for Nero AI Image Upscaler API. Upscale images with AI-powered enhancement (2x or 4x scaling).

post.description: Submit an image for AI-powered upscaling. Supports 2x and 4x scaling with quality optimization. Returns a task_id for status monitoring.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Upscale request parameters including image URL, quality settings, and scaling options

200.description: Response from the API. Check the 'code' field in the response body to determine success or failure. Business errors (11002, 11003, 11004) return HTTP 200 with error details in the response body.

429.description: Too Many Requests - rate limit exceeded (10 requests per second)

get.description: Monitor the progress and retrieve results of an upscaling task. Check status, progress percentage, and get the final upscaled image URL.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Unique task identifier returned from the UpscaleImage operation

200.description: Response from the API. Check the 'code' field in the response body to determine success or failure. Business errors (11002, 11003, 11004) return HTTP 200 with error details in the response body.

429.description: Too Many Requests - rate limit exceeded (10 requests per second)

image.description: Public URL of the image to upscale. Must be accessible via HTTPS. Supported formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, WEBP, JFIF, JFI, JPE, JIF, ICO

quality_factor.description: Quality factor for the upscaled result. Higher values produce better quality but may take longer to process. Range: [80, 100], default: 95. Only effective for JPG, JPEG, or WEBP formats.

upscaling_rate.description: Upscaling multiplier. 2x for moderate enhancement, 4x for maximum detail enhancement. Face enhancement does not support upscaling rate.

type.description: AI model type for image processing. Choose based on your image content for optimal results.

body.description: Core upscaling parameters including image URL and quality settings

info.description: Additional request metadata for tracking and debugging

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for request tracing and support

webhook.description: Optional webhook URL to receive task completion notifications. If webhook invoke fails, it will be retried three times.

code.description: Response status code. 0 indicates success, other values indicate errors.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the upscaling task. Use this ID to check processing status.

code.description: Response status code. 0 indicates success, other values indicate errors.

data.description: Detailed task information including current status and results

status.description: Current processing status of the task

pending_count.description: Number of tasks ahead in the processing queue (only when status is 'pending')

progress.description: Processing progress as a percentage (only when status is 'running')

result.description: Final result containing the upscaled image URL (only when status is 'done')

output.description: Direct download URL for the upscaled image

msg.description: Error message explaining why the task failed (only when status is 'failed')
msg.example: Image processing failed due to unsupported format

ErrorResponse.description: Error response format. Business errors (11002, 11003, 11004)   11002 - The API key is invalid, 11003 - The API key is expired,  11004 - The remaining credits of API key are insufficient.

code.description: Error code indicating the type of error.

api_key.name: x-neroai-api-key
api_key.description: Your Nero AI API key for authentication. Do not expose this key publicly as it allows access to all authenticated APIs and will cost your credits.

uiDefinition.description: Connect to Nero AI Image Upscaler to enhance your images with AI-powered upscaling
